captions.detailed: A modern steel campanile bell tower featuring a tall, open, square-profile lattice shaft constructed from grey steel trusses. It stands on a flat concrete-like base plate and is topped by a flat, dark grey cap. Inside the upper section of the lattice tower, a bronze-colored bell is suspended from a dark horizontal headstock beam, allowing it to swing back and forth around a horizontal revolute joint axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a modern steel campanile bell tower. The tower should feature a tall, square-profile steel lattice shaft resting on a solid base, capped with a flat plate at the top. Inside the upper belfry stage, include a bronze-colored bell mounted on a horizontal headstock beam via a revolute joint, allowing the bell to swing dynamically.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a static 'tower' part. This tower is assembled from a flat base plate (Box), four vertical corner columns (Cylinders or Boxes), cross-bracing diagonal steel lattice members, and a flat top cover plate. A second dynamic 'bell' part is created by modeling a flared bell shape (using lofted or revolved profiles) attached to a horizontal headstock beam. Finally, a revolute joint is defined connecting the bell's headstock to the upper structural frame of the tower, aligned along the horizontal pitch axis.
